verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations that do not meet business requirements. That is a first-party, authorization-time spend-control mechanism, but the evidence never says these rules can target merchant category codes or specific merchants. Relayed authorisation lets you decide in real time on your own servers, but that is a building block for custom logic rather than a native MCC or merchant-lock control. Missing for 10: explicit MCC allowlist/blocklist rule documentation, single-merchant lock support, ops-facing configuration details for these restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
